name: MSP trial sequence (the client's offer to the client's prospects)
source: Structure of Sequence T (The 30-Day Trial, Section 10): plain text, no links in email 1, one reply CTA, four touches. Wording is new, written for the client's own offer; the client reviews it on the approval page and the owner edits it in Mission Control on request.

touches.subject: @variant

touches.body:
{FirstName}, a quick follow-up. We look after day-to-day IT for {ICP}, so your team has one number to call when something breaks.

Is it worth a short call to see if that fits {Company}?

touches.subject: IT at {Company}

touches.body:
{FirstName}, I don't want to crowd your inbox, so this is my last note. If IT support comes up for {Company} later, just reply and I'll pick it up.

Should I close the file for now?
